help.title: PlanetLogi Help Center
help.subtitle: Frequently asked questions for Elementary Students, Parents, and Schools.
help.q1: What are Daily Orbit operating hours?
help.a1: Daily Orbit opens 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM in your local timezone to encourage healthy daily study habits without late-night screen time.
help.q2: How do Cryo Shields protect an Orbit Streak?
help.a2: You can hold up to 3 Cryo Shields. If a day is missed, 1 shield automatically activates at midnight so your streak stays safe.
help.q3: Can we switch between English and Bahasa Indonesia anytime?
help.a3: Yes! Both UI and math questions support English and Indonesian side-by-side from the top bar or Parent Settings.
